booking.thankYou: Thank you, {{name}}. We look forward to welcoming you to Park Regency.

home.heroSub: Where the desert meets the sea — an enclave of timeless elegance on the shores of the Sinai Peninsula.
home.welcomeTitle: A sanctuary of refined elegance by the sea
home.welcomeP1: Set along a private stretch of Sharm El Sheikh's most coveted coastline, Park Regency is more than a resort — it is a destination woven from light, water, and discreet luxury.
home.welcomeP2: From sunrise yoga on the sand to candlelit dinners beneath the stars, every moment is shaped by intuitive service and the rhythm of the Red Sea.

highlights.beachesText: Pristine turquoise shores reserved exclusively for our guests.
highlights.spaText: Holistic rituals inspired by the timeless wisdom of the Sinai.
highlights.diningText: Seven signature venues curated by world-renowned chefs.
highlights.divingText: Discover the Red Sea's legendary reefs with PADI experts.
highlights.clubText: A private enclave with personal butler service and exclusive lounges.
highlights.weddingText: Beachfront ceremonies and ballrooms for your defining moment.

rooms.seaViewDesc: Sweeping Red Sea panoramas from a private balcony.
rooms.seaFrontDesc: Direct beach access and unobstructed ocean horizons.
rooms.suiteDesc: Opulent living quarters with personal butler and private dining.

home.diningText: From the refined flavors of Sala Thai to the breezy Mediterranean spirit of Beach House, seven distinct venues celebrate the art of dining.
home.experiencesTitle: Crafted moments, by land and sea
home.weddingsTitle: Say "I do" by the Red Sea
home.weddingsText: Beachfront ceremonies, candlelit dinners, and bespoke celebrations crafted by our dedicated wedding atelier.
home.meetingsText: A flagship conference center hosting up to 700 guests, supported by intuitive event planners and seamless production.

footer.tagline: A landmark of luxury hospitality on the shores of the Red Sea — where timeless elegance meets unforgettable experiences in Gardens Bay, Sharm El Sheikh.
